title: Fall Commencement
description: Missouri State University holds its fall commencement ceremonies to celebrate graduates, with guests attending in person or watching the livestream. The 10 a.m. ceremony covers the Darr College of Agriculture, College of Business, College of Natural and Applied Sciences, and Interdisciplinary Academic Programs, while the 1:30 p.m. ceremony covers the McQueary College of Health and Human Services, Reynolds College of Arts, Social Sciences, and Humanities, and College of Education. No ticket is required and there is no limit on guests per graduate; doors open 90 minutes before each ceremony, and guests pass through security where only clear bags are permitted.
